text: one thing your gonna run into that is probably a problem is that the map generation assumes that the world can rotate buildings t o any degree but building pieces live on a 90 degree axis as far as im concerned so there would need to be real adjustments to parity that behavior
resolution: Adjusted building-site generation to the editor's 3-metre, quarter-turn piece grammar. Every site center is module-snapped, yaw is restricted to 0/90/180/270, the rotated footprint is recomputed after snapping, and the final footprint is rejected when wet, protected, overlapping, or too close to native-parity curved transport geometry.
